title: IVG Pro Salts Blue Sour Strawberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Blue Sour Strawberry 10ml E-Liquid offers a unique twist on popular sour berry blends. It begins with the familiar, dark sweetness of juicy Blueberry, providing a smooth and satisfying inhale. The flavour then develops into a sharp, zesty finish provided by a bold layer of Sour Strawberry, delivering a bright and tangy contrast that keeps the palate feeling cleansed and refreshed. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the vivid berry notes of Blue Sour Strawberry, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the sparkling Purple Lemonade or the deeply indulgent Fizzy Cherry, ensuring a premium option for every palate.
